thought.text: Docker Hub works. Now let me create the `.env` file in `deployment/` per the documented setup.

reasoning_content:
Docker Hub connectivity is working. Next, I'll create a .env file in deployment/ following the documentation (Section 2.1, for dev compose with local HTTPS). The guide's Quick Start says `docker-compose up -d --build`, which uses docker-compose.yml (production), but that requires a domain. Since this is a localhost environment with no domain, the dev compose with Caddy's internal CA is the correct approach.

I'll create the .env according to the README's dev section:

```
DJANGO_SECRET_KEY=14fd187fffff16302993093234b7470baf0525d35f809c190a127f9053d7fbb1
DJANGO_ALLOWED_HOSTS=api.localhost,admin.localhost,localhost,127.0.0.1
DEBUG=True
CSRF_TRUSTED_ORIGINS=https://api.localhost,https://app.localhost,https://admin.localhost

DB_NAME=qonnectra
DB_USER=qonnectra_user
DB_PASSWORD=d80df876bf968e44833b8b445a268800
DB_HOST=db
DB_PORT=5432

DEFAULT_SRID=25832
CORS_ALLOWED_ORIGINS=https://app.localhost

DJANGO_SUPERUSER_USERNAME=admin
DJANGO_SUPERUSER_EMAIL=admin@example.com
DJANGO_SUPERUSER_PASSWORD=...

USE_COOKIE_DOMAIN_MIDDLEWARE=True
COOKIE_DOMAIN=.localhost
```

Also, the dev compose uses QGIS_DB_USER and QGIS_DB_PASSWORD — init.sh creates the QGIS user if they are provided. The prod template has these. I'll include them (needed for QGIS WFS/WMS access). The dev README section doesn't list them, but init.sh supports them, and QGIS needs them for pg_service.conf. I'll add QGIS_DB_USER=qgis_user and a QGIS_DB_PASSWORD.

Alright, let's create the .env and run compose config to verify.

action.command:
cat > /workspace/deployment/.env <<'EOF'
# Django Settings
DJANGO_SECRET_KEY=14fd187fffff16302993093234b7470baf0525d35f809c190a127f9053d7fbb1
DJANGO_ALLOWED_HOSTS=api.localhost,admin.localhost,localhost,127.0.0.1
DEBUG=True
CSRF_TRUSTED_ORIGINS=https://api.localhost,https://app.localhost,https://admin.localhost

# Database
DB_NAME=qonnectra
DB_USER=qonnectra_user
DB_PASSWORD=d80df876bf968e44833b8b445a268800
DB_HOST=db
DB_PORT=5432

# QGIS database user (for WFS/WMS)
QGIS_DB_USER=qgis_user
QGIS_DB_PASSWORD=6a91c3e04b5278fd1c23b4a8e0d917c5

# Spatial Data
DEFAULT_SRID=25832

# CORS
CORS_ALLOWED_ORIGINS=https://app.localhost

# Django Superuser
DJANGO_SUPERUSER_USERNAME=admin
DJANGO_SUPERUSER_EMAIL=admin@example.com
DJANGO_SUPERUSER_PASSWORD=Admin!LocalDev123

# Cookie Domain (for cross-subdomain cookies)
USE_COOKIE_DOMAIN_MIDDLEWARE=True
COOKIE_DOMAIN=.localhost

# Frontend build args
API_URL=https://api.localhost/api/v1/
PUBLIC_API_URL=https://api.localhost/api/v1/
PUBLIC_TILE_SERVER_URL=https://tiles.localhost
EOF
echo "created"; cat /workspace/deployment/.env | wc -l
